collection.description: A child notices that the shoreline has moved since yesterday.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) notices that the shoreline has moved since yesterday.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a researcher, explains that the moon and sun influence ocean tides.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks why the tide does not change at exactly the same time each day.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) records how far the water reaches.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A high tide washes away the marks, teaching (child) to choose a safer place.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) explains why tides matter for nearshore work.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) learns that currents can be dangerous even when water looks calm.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) tells a tide legend as a story.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) compares the tale with the daily waterline.
